name: mcp-zotero
description: Unofficial Zotero integration: search your library, add papers by DOI, import PDFs, read full text and inject live Zotero citations into Word documents.
long_description:
Gives Claude access to your Zotero library through the Zotero Web API: search and browse collections, add items by DOI (with open-access PDFs found via Unpaywall) or from metadata, import PDFs, read the full text indexed by Zotero, and turn `<zcite>` placeholders in a .docx file into native Zotero citations that Zotero for Word can refresh.

You need a Zotero API key (zotero.org/settings/keys, with library read/write and file access) and your numeric user ID, shown on the same page. Deletions are disabled unless you change *Deletions allowed*. To work on a group library, set *Library type* to `group` and *Group library ID*.

This is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the Zotero team or the Corporation for Digital Scholarship. "Zotero" is a registered trademark of the Corporation for Digital Scholarship.

tools.name: get_collections
tools.description: List all collections (folders) in your Zotero library.

tools.name: get_collection_items
tools.description: Get all items in a specific Zotero collection.

tools.name: get_items_details
tools.description: Get metadata for multiple Zotero items in a single call.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search your Zotero library or list items sorted by a field.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection (folder) in your Zotero library.

tools.name: add_items_by_doi
tools.description: Add items to your Zotero library by resolving DOIs.

tools.name: inject_citations
tools.description: Replace <zcite> placeholder tags in a .docx file with native Zotero field codes that Zotero for Word can recognize and manage.

tools.name: get_item_fulltext
tools.description: Get the full text content of a Zotero item's PDF attachment via Zotero's fulltext index.

tools.name: get_user_id
tools.description: Returns the Zotero library configured in the server environment: user_id, library_type, library_id and library_path ("users/<id>" or "groups/<id>").

tools.name: add_linked_url_attachment
tools.description: Attach a linked URL to an existing Zotero item, or create a standalone linked-URL attachment.

tools.name: add_items
tools.description: Add items to Zotero by providing metadata directly.

tools.name: import_pdf_to_zotero
tools.description: Download a PDF from a URL and upload it to Zotero storage as an imported_url attachment.

tools.name: find_and_attach_pdfs
tools.description: For each Zotero item, check Unpaywall for open access PDFs and attach them.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete a collection (folder) from your Zotero library.

tools.name: delete_items
tools.description: Delete one or more items from your Zotero library: they are permanently deleted (not moved to the Zotero trash).

zotero_api_key.title: Zotero API key
zotero_api_key.description: Create one at zotero.org/settings/keys with library read/write and file access.

zotero_user_id.title: Zotero user ID
zotero_user_id.description: Your numeric user ID, shown on zotero.org/settings/keys (it is not your username).

zotero_library_id.title: Group library ID
zotero_library_id.description: Numeric group ID, required when the library type is 'group'. Leave empty for your personal library.

unpaywall_email.title: Email for Unpaywall
unpaywall_email.description: Optional. Sent to the Unpaywall API to find open-access PDFs when adding papers by DOI; leave empty to skip the PDF lookup.
